name: Transcendence
overview: Scripture reveals God's transcendence as the Creator who exists beyond and above His creation, initiating all things by creating the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1). While God forms humanity intimately from the dust and breathes life into man (Genesis 2:7), His nature and wisdom remain beyond human comprehension, as Job challenges us to recognize that we cannot fully search out or understand the Almighty (Job 11:7). God's sovereign power is further displayed in His sustaining of the earth, which He hangs upon nothing (Job 26:7), underscoring His supreme authority over all things.
